events.caption: Second trial: start above the active region.
Now watch the velocity amplification, not only the resting seed.

setup: First release from rest inside the region; then launch above it to expose the amplification update.
name: Acceleration zone

oracle.name: Acceleration zone
oracle.law: Within the yellow tile's footprint (|x|<2, |y|<2), at any height, each step sets v_x=0.35 for s=|\mathbf v|<0.35, or scales \mathbf v by 1.0015 for 0.35≤ s<6. Only red and blue balls receive this update. All ordinary forces still act, and there is no update outside the zone or at s≥6.
oracle.condition: Red or blue lies inside the yellow footprint, at any height.
oracle.effect: The world injects motion: an eastward seed at low speed, amplification below speed 6.
oracle.scope: Updates occur each physics step. Ordinary forces remain active, so net speed need not increase every instant.

reference: Same geometry, masses and scripted actions; the altered program is disabled only in the ordinary-physics reference.
